result.instructions: Tools for Cobalt Intelligence, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which states can I search for business records?"; "Find the Secretary of State records for a business named Deere & Company in Missouri."; "Look up a business by its Secretary of State filing id in Delaware.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cobalt Intelligence data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cobaltintelligence_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cobaltintelligence_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cobaltintelligence_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cobaltintelligence_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cobaltintelligence_list_states
tools.title: List searchable states
tools.description: List the state names the other tools accept, from Cobalt's search index. Call this first to pick a valid state. Cobalt API: GET /v1/search/index.

tools.name: cobaltintelligence_search_businesses
tools.title: Find businesses by name
tools.description: Find business entities in one state whose name matches search_query. Returns candidate matches; pick one, then call cobaltintelligence_get_business or cobaltintelligence_get_business_by_sos_id. Cobalt API: GET /v1/search/list. Entity records only. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. Do not use it to screen, score or decide on any person's employment, credit, insurance, housing or tenancy.

state.description: State name as cobaltintelligence_list_states returns it, e.g. mississippi.

live_data.description: Set false to use Cobalt's stored data instead of a live lookup.

tools.name: cobaltintelligence_get_business
tools.title: Get a business record by name
tools.description: Get the Secretary of State record for one business name in one state. Add city or zip to narrow a common name. A slow search returns a retryId; check it with cobaltintelligence_get_search_result. Cobalt API: GET /v1/search. Entity records only. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. Do not use it to screen, score or decide on any person's employment, credit, insurance, housing or tenancy.

state.description: State name as cobaltintelligence_list_states returns it, e.g. mississippi.

zip.description: ZIP code to narrow the match.

live_data.description: Set false to use Cobalt's stored data instead of a live lookup.

annotations.title: Get a business record by name

tools.name: cobaltintelligence_get_business_by_sos_id
tools.title: Get a business record by SOS id
tools.description: Get the Secretary of State record for one filing id (SOS id) in one state. Use the id from cobaltintelligence_search_businesses or a previous record. A slow search returns a retryId. Cobalt API: GET /v1/search?sosId=. Entity records only. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. Do not use it to screen, score or decide on any person's employment, credit, insurance, housing or tenancy.

state.description: State name as cobaltintelligence_list_states returns it, e.g. mississippi.

live_data.description: Set false to use Cobalt's stored data instead of a live lookup.

annotations.title: Get a business record by SOS id

tools.name: cobaltintelligence_get_search_result
tools.title: Check a slow search
tools.description: Check a search that returned a retryId. Makes one call and does not wait. Call again later if the status is still Incomplete. Cobalt API: GET /v1/search?retryId=. Entity records only. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. Do not use it to screen, score or decide on any person's employment, credit, insurance, housing or tenancy.

retry_id.description: The retryId from an earlier search.
